title: Boomerang Nebula vs. NASA's Cold Atom Lab (Kelvin)
geography: Deep space vs. the International Space Station

source.name: Cold Atom Laboratory Chills Atoms to New Lows

notes: NASA's Cold Atom Lab aboard the ISS chills atoms to under 100 picokelvin (1x10^-10 K) -- NASA describes this as about a billion times colder than the vacuum of deep space.
